cards.t: Samsung Wallet Integrates USDC for Cross-Border Transfers
cards.b: Samsung is integrating USDC into Samsung Wallet to allow US Galaxy users to send cross-border payments and local-currency payouts to bank accounts in over 60 countries starting late October.

per.USDC: Will be integrated into Samsung Wallet for cross-border remittances by US Galaxy users.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact day in late October.

cards.t: EU Securities Regulator Gives Crypto Platforms 3 Months to Remove Non-Compliant Stablecoins
cards.b: ESMA has instructed authorized crypto platforms in the EU to block new access to stablecoins that fail to meet MiCA rules within a 3-month window while national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.

per.USDC: Subject to EU MiCA compliance evaluations across authorized platforms.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific list of non-compliant stablecoins impacted.

cards.b: CME Futures for Bitcoin Cash are scheduled to launch on October 19, bringing regulated derivatives exposure to the asset.

per.BCH: Set to launch on CME Futures on October 19.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Contract specifications and opening hour details.

cards.t: Securitize Launches Tokenized US Equities on Solana
cards.b: Securitize has launched tokenized shares of 12 US companies—including Apple, Nvidia, and Tesla—backed 1-to-1 with dividend and voting rights, trading first on Solana with plans for NYSE and OKX-ICE venues.

per.SOL: Hosts the initial trading venue for Securitize's new tokenized US equities platform.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch dates for the NYSE and OKX-ICE expansions.
